headline: Gold prices fall 2% as bets on Fed rates boost dollar
summary: Gold prices fell more than 2% to their lowest level in over a year, pressured by a stronger dollar. Bets on Federal Reserve interest rates are supporting the currency.
why: Gold is a non-yielding asset whose price is sensitive to the US dollar and expectations for US interest rates.
why_moved: A stronger dollar, supported by bets on Federal Reserve rates, pressured gold to a one-year low.
original_headline: Precios del oro caen 2% mientras apuestas sobre tasas de la Fed impulsan al dólar
